newsitem.title: USA: Canadian spot natgas prices hold in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Canadian spot natgas prices hold in light trade.

text.p: Canadian spot natural gas prices were mostly steady Tuesday in light trade as temperatures moderated and storage injections slowed in the West, traders said.
Spot gas at the AECO storage hub in Alberta was quoted flat at C$1.67-1.69 per gigajoule (GJ). June AECO was talked at C$1.65-1.67, while June/October business was quoted at C$1.67 per GJ.
"People are backing off of daily storage injections," one Calgary-based trader said, noting cheaper prices for next week discouraged buyers from purhasing storage gas today.
Temperatures in Calgary are expected to reach a high of about 14 degrees Celsius today before turning warmer Wednesday and Thursday, according to Weather Services Corp.

At Sumas, Wash., prices climbed one cent to about $1.36-1.37 per million British thermal units, while Niagara prices ignored the NYMEX rally by remaining in the mid-to-high $2.40s, market sources said.
